description: Observed public storefront capabilities. Every entry is backed by evidence URLs from the crawl.

features.description: Products are organised into top-level categories, with a nested set of capsule subcategories reachable from the header navigation.
implementationNotes: 8 categories observed, including nested children.
2 navigation pages list no products at the moment and still render as valid pages.
features.name: Category browsing

features.description: A navigation page for vending customers: a paragraph of descriptive copy above a product listing with the usual filters.
implementationNotes: It lists no products at the moment, and renders its empty state rather than a 404.
It is absent from the structured catalog's category list: it is navigation, not a category a product belongs to.
The copy on it is the source's own and is never mirrored.
features.name: Vending Zone page

features.description: A navigation page for consumables sold beside the coffee: a paragraph of descriptive copy above a product listing with the usual filters.
implementationNotes: It lists no products at the moment, and renders its empty state rather than a 404.
It is absent from the structured catalog's category list: it is navigation, not a category a product belongs to.
The copy on it is the source's own and is never mirrored.
features.name: Consumables page

features.description: Brands are first-class: an index page lists every brand, and each brand has its own listing page with a description and product count.
implementationNotes: 20 brands carry products; the index also lists brands with none.
Brand pages filter by category, the inverse of category pages, which filter by brand.
features.name: Brand browsing

features.description: Each product has a detail page with name, image, price, pack size, availability, intensity, a short description, a longer write-up, breadcrumbs and related products.
implementationNotes: The source has listed products with no price and with no pack size before; both must render gracefully.
The longer write-up is the source's prose: the storefront writes its own or shows none.
features.name: Product detail page

features.description: Each product page prints a short product code among its attributes.
implementationNotes: The same code is the `sku` of the page's Product structured data.
It is a string: leading zeros are part of it.
The catalog listing does not carry it; it is read from the product page.
features.name: Product code

features.description: Below the write-up, product pages print a labelled list of characteristics: what the coffee is made of, where it comes from, how it tastes, what it fits.
implementationNotes: Labels seen most often: Вкусов профил, Състав, Съвместимост, Послевкус, Съвместима система, Произход, Съвместими капсули, Подходящо за.
The list is written by hand and its markup varies; a label may be missing from any page.
Only what a page states is shown: a missing label is an omitted row, never a guess.
features.name: Product characteristics list

features.description: Listing pages expose filters whose state is encoded in URL search parameters.
implementationNotes: Reference filtering is client-side show/hide over a fully rendered list.
A server-rendered equivalent is required for our storefront so filtered pages are crawlable.
features.name: Catalog filtering

features.description: A promotions route lists products carrying a reduced price. The capability exists and is currently empty.
implementationNotes: Every observed product has an empty `old_price`, so no promotion is active right now.
The route must render a proper empty state rather than 404.
features.name: Promotions

features.description: Instead of a cart and checkout, each product offers a single phone-number field. The shop calls back to confirm the order.
implementationNotes: There is no cart and no online checkout anywhere on the reference site.
The reference posts to a third-party CMS endpoint; ours must post to our own API and persist locally.
features.name: Quick order by phone

features.description: A footer email field offers a discount in exchange for subscribing.
implementationNotes: Must store consent locally rather than forwarding to the source.
features.name: Newsletter signup

features.description: Product pages show a carousel of other products from the same area of the catalog.
implementationNotes: No explicit relationship is published, so ours is derived from category and brand.
features.name: Related products

features.description: Product pages show shop → category → product.
features.name: Breadcrumb navigation

features.description: A blog index lists the published articles, and each article has a page of its own.
implementationNotes: 1 article observed.
An article is the source's own writing: the capability is matched, the text is never mirrored.
features.name: Blog

features.description: Privacy policy, general terms and cookie settings are published.
implementationNotes: Content must be written for our business, never copied.
features.name: Legal and policy pages

features.description: A dismissible banner at the top of every page. It currently states the order value above which delivery is free, beside a one-line pitch for ordering by phone.
implementationNotes: What the banner says is the source's own message. A storefront banner states its own terms, never these.
Dismissing it is remembered in the browser, so it stays closed on later pages.
features.name: Sitewide notice banner

features.description: The shop states, on every page, the order value above which delivery is free.
implementationNotes: Threshold stated by the source: 49€.
That figure is the source's commercial term. Ours is configuration, and is shown only when it is set.
features.name: Free-delivery threshold

features.description: The footer of every page lists the ways an order can be paid for.
implementationNotes: Methods listed: cash-on-delivery, bank-transfer, card.
Nothing is paid on the site: there is no checkout. The list informs an order placed by phone.
The source's wording for each method is not reused; ours comes from configuration.
features.name: Listed payment methods

features.description: A phone number is present in the header and footer as a direct `tel:` link.
features.name: Phone contact
